title: Let dust scatter while the new friend settles
problem: At f2504 the new friend is already on the floor; f2550 confirms reduced ears, missing pearl/curl details and simplified body. The concept must remain intact after landing.
beats: Continue the exact accepted R10 endpoint: the little bunny has landed and the big casing is already collapsed into low drifting dust.
Over the next seconds the dust spreads gently outward near the floor and thins; the little bunny’s ears settle and the four helpers lower their tools.
The little friend smiles as the remaining dust settles into a faint floor residue; no intact giant or shell remains.
end_state: The concept-matching rainbow bunny and four helpers rest together as the last low dust wisps settle; the big bunny is gone through visible collapse and dispersal.
